biography_english:
A lover of ale and women, given to a life of debauchery. He was killed after drawing steel against a band of pirates.
  Like other residents of Port Omish, nothing is known of his past.
biography_spanish:
Amante de cerveza y mujeres, dado a la mala vida. Muri{bF3} tras desenfundar contra unos piratas.
  Como otros vecinos de Puerto Omish, nada se sabe de su pasado.

biography_english:
A legendary Galgastani pirate. In his younger days, he was known to all who sailed the coastal waters of Valeria, and his name struck fear into their hearts. Said to have returned unscathed from the deadly Pirate's Graveyard.
  After his daughter was slain in battle, he put his plundering days behind him. He went on to lead a life of debauchery at Port Omish, until the ravages of war compelled him to take up his blade once more.
  He led {hero} into the depths of the Pirate's Graveyard and revealed the secret of its treasure.
biography_spanish:
Legendario pirata galgastani. De joven lo conocian todos los que navegaban las aguas de Valeria y su nombre causaba terror. Se dice que regreso ileso del peligroso Cementerio de Piratas.
  Tras morir su hija en batalla, dejo la pirateria. Paso a llevar una vida de excesos en Puerto Omish, hasta que la guerra lo obligo a tomar la espada otra vez.
  Guio a {hero} a las profundidades del Cementerio de Piratas y revelo el secreto de su tesoro.

biography_english: A Walister serving with the Order of {order}. He is a spellbinder with an air of confidence about him. Before war broke out he had a small apothecary in Almorica. He joined the Resistance when his wife became a casualty of the conflict. In the early days he put his experience to use by gathering herbs and preparing medicinal concoctions. When Duke Ronwey was imprisoned upon the defeat of the Walister army, he resolved to take up arms. Despite his advanced years, he does not shy from battle.
biography_spanish: Un walister al servicio de la Orden de {order}. Es un encantador con un aire de confianza. Antes de estallar la guerra tenia una peque{bF1}a botica en Almorica. Se unio a la Resistencia cuando su esposa cayo victima del conflicto. Al principio aprovecho su experiencia recogiendo hierbas y preparando menjunjes medicinales. Cuando el duque Ronwey fue encarcelado tras la derrota del ejercito walister, decidio tomar las armas. A pesar de su avanzada edad, no huye del combate.

biography_english:
A Walister serving with the Order of {order}. When war broke out she was a mage-knight with the Knights of Almorica. She was present at the first engagement between Galgastani and Walister forces at the Arkhaiopolis of Rhime. She takes great pride in fighting for the Walister, but as a result tends to be overcritical and hardheaded.
  She has deep respect for Leonar, who rallied the knights together after Duke Ronwey's capture.
biography_spanish:
Una walister al servicio de la Orden de {order}. Al estallar la guerra era caballero maga de los Caballeros de Almorica. Estuvo en el primer combate entre las fuerzas de Galgastan y los walister en la Arquiopolis de Rhime. Se siente muy orgullosa de luchar por los walister, pero suele ser hipercritica y obstinada.
  Siente un gran respeto por Leonar, quien reunio a los caballeros tras la captura del duque Ronwey.

biography_english:
A taciturn and earnest Walister of the Knights of Almorica who serves in the Order of {order}.
  He was garrisoned in Rhime when the Bakram invaded, and fought them alongside the Xenobian knights. Upon the fall of Rhime, he broke through enemy lines and returned to Almorica Castle. He has stared death in the face many a time, yet still lives on.
biography_spanish:
Un walister taciturno y serio de los Caballeros de Almorica al servicio de la Orden de {order}.
  Estaba apostado en Rhime cuando los bakram invadieron, y lucho junto a los caballeros xenobianos. Tras la caida de Rhime, rompio las lineas enemigas y regreso al Castillo de Almorica. Ha visto la muerte a la cara muchas veces, pero sigue con vida.

biography_english:
Former captain of a band of pirates based in Qadriga Fortress who terrorized the surrounding waters. The pirates call themselves the "Free Seas," and set themselves above other sea raiders. Their wrath often falls upon naval ports, warships, and the vessels of nobles, and some say there is more to their actions than mere plundering.
  He offered to join forces with the Resistance, but was rebuffed. He was killed in the battle that ensued.
biography_spanish:
Excapitan de una banda de piratas afincada en la Fortaleza de Qadriga que aterrorizaba las aguas cercanas. Los piratas se autodenominan los "Mares Libres" y se consideran superiores a otros saqueadores. Su ira suele caer sobre puertos navales, buques de guerra y embarcaciones de nobles; hay quien dice que sus actos van mas alla del pillaje.
  Ofrecio unirse a la Resistencia, pero fue rechazado y murio en la batalla.

biography_english:
A Bakram formerly with the Liberation Front. He was at sea when the Dark Knights attacked Boed Fortress to wipe out the Liberation Front, and so escaped with his life.
  After meeting up with Cerya at Rhime, they set out for Qadriga Fortress to rebuild their forces. They continued the work of the Liberation Front under the guise of pirates, calling themselves the "Free Seas."
biography_spanish:
Un bakram que pertenecio al Frente de Liberacion. Estaba en el mar cuando los Caballeros Oscuros atacaron la Fortaleza de Boed para exterminar al Frente, por lo que salvo la vida.
  Tras reunirse con Cerya en Rhime, partieron a la Fortaleza de Qadriga para reconstruir sus fuerzas. Continuaron la labor del Frente bajo la apariencia de piratas, llamandose los "Mares Libres". ."
